name: astril - Run from patient metadata (test data only)
desc: TEST DATA ONLY: input is pre-skull-strip (DICOM headers, faces) and real patient data here is PHI. Plans DICOM to NIfTI conversion from the filled-in metadata table, then converts, preprocesses, segments and quantifies in one run. Use 'Stop after' = Plan conversion to review or edit the plan first, then continue with 'astril - Run from conversion plan'. Versions: astril-nf 0.2.0, astril 0.7.31.
fileRequirementsMessage: PHI WARNING: upload only de-identified, face-free TEST data here. Real patient DICOM or NIfTI contains PHI (headers, identifiable faces) and must not be uploaded to Cirro; run those stages locally and upload 02-preprocess/upload_preprocessed/ instead. Input: an 'astril - Organize DICOM' dataset; select the filled-in metadata table in the form.
